entities.title: Retire knowledge-driven development from processes
entities.summary: Knowledge-driven development is superseded by human-assisted software development, and processes no longer offers it.
entities.context: processes carried a knowledge-driven-development skill, its READMEs offered it, and the deployable-documentation templates carried its marks. Human-assisted software development covers the same ground with .dev folders and knowledge files.
entities.decision: Remove the knowledge-driven-development skill, stop offering it in the READMEs, and take its marks out of the deployable-documentation templates: requirements and architecture point at the .dev records a HASD repository keeps, and status columns say met, not met or not checked. Repositories that adopted it keep following it in its own repository.

entities.title: The agent skills and the .dev browser live outside processes
entities.summary: The describe-* skills, their schemas, examples and validator, and the page that draws .dev folders moved out of processes; processes links to them and keeps a copy of the skills only to check its own .dev files.
entities.context: processes held the architecture browser and the describe-* skills with their schemas, examples and validate_diagrams.py. The knowledge catalogue they belong with is in the human-assisted-software-development repository.
entities.decision: Move the browser and the skills to human-assisted-software-development, next to the knowledge catalogue, and link to them from the README. The browser has since moved on to its own repository, the Cyberspace explorer.
